work.title: Remove ManifestStore-Worktree hooks
work.description: Remove the checkpoint callbacks that reconcile manifest contents inside live worktrees (onCheckpoint, onRefreshPreflight, onRefreshed), replacing them with explicit orchestration inside application use cases only where still necessary.
acceptance: ManifestRepository construction no longer requires WorktreeManager hooks
Manifest writes have no hidden checkout side effects
No manifest index reconciliation remains for new-format Works
Refresh preflight is an explicit application operation
Tests prove a manifest checkpoint cannot modify a worktree
